topic.label: ntfy topic
topic.description: The topic you send to, like mydesk-7f3k. Anyone who knows it can send, so pick something hard to guess. demo shows sample messages.

server.label: ntfy server
server.description: https://ntfy.sh, or the address of your own ntfy server.

token.label: Access token
token.description: Optional, for a protected topic: a token that starts with tk_.

interval.label: Seconds between checks
interval.description: How often the bar asks the server for new messages.

min_priority.label: Show from priority
min_priority.description: Messages below this priority are left out.

sound.label: Sound
sound.description: A sound when a message of this priority or higher arrives.

blink.label: Blink the light
blink.description: Blink the status light in the message's color when one arrives.
